reviews.comment: She was an amazing person and prof. I did struggle with the pop quizzes because literally I never got an A on them even when I read the material. Lots of reading every week but just try to understand the key concepts of the readings. Final group project and be prepared for cold calls. Also there are discussion posts about the week's materials.

reviews.comment: Awesome professor! class is always super interesting. discussion of current issues but prof makes a good effort at looking at facts and both sides of the issue. prof also encourages discussions in class even if you disagree. great learning environment, i never felt uncomfortable speaking in class. overall very interesting class and i learned a lot.

reviews.comment:
I took this class partly because I saw an article that called it “far left ideology” but as someone who's actually active in the political space, this is some of the most entry level and tame sociology material ever😭

She's nice and cheerful, can come across as a little intense if you're not being used to challenged on your perspective.

reviews.comment: Classes are more general discussion than lectures, but it encourages participation and is genuinely very interesting to listen to. This professor clearly cares about the subject matter she teaches, and she makes a serious effort to get to know her students and make them feel welcome to attend and speak up in class. Great class and great professor.

reviews.comment: Dr. Pathakis has been one of my favorite professors at A&M, she is very insightful and the course is interesting. She is inclusive of all opinions without pushing a certain agenda. I always felt comfortable in her class.There are readings/videos for every class day, but they're interesting, few pop quizzes, but weren't bad if you did the readings.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is truly the one professor at Texas A&M and in the Bush school that has truly made me excited to come to class. If you're willing to work hard, have an open mind, and contribute, you will do great. she is amazing, changing lives one class at a time. Truly a privilege to learn from her.

There are weekly readings, all of your learning comes from these they are interesting but very long. The class modules are unorganized and you can't miss class because there are pop quizzes at random weekly. Professor is knowledgeable, but can be incredibly passive aggressive. Don't miss anything it will hurt your grade, keep up and it's an easy A.

reviews.comment: Widely unorganized and hard to reach. Will not try to help students in any capacity but expects responses immediately.

If you have an open mind and want to learn about race relations, you will learn valuable information in this course. Class is easy but has pop quizzes that are sometimes obscure and vague writing guidelines. Asking questions may have unintended negative consequences on student-professor relations. Overall, not a bad class, but make sure to read.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Pathakis is a super sweet professor who cares about having engaging discussions in class and having us consider multiple viewpoints. The weekly readings, videos, and podcasts were super interesting, you just have to make sure to do them! She also gives great advice and truly cares about her students. Not a hard class, but you learn a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is the best class I have ever taken at A&M. Dr. Pathakis is a great lecturer and so engaging. I genuinely look forward to coming to class every day. As long as you do the assigned readings, you have nothing to worry about. There is a discussion post due every week, the occasional pop quiz, and one paper due at the end of the semester. 10/10
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Pathakis is a super sweet, caring professor. Discussion is always really interesting too, she loves when people have opposing view points. She cold calls in class but its all for extra credit. Quizzes almost every week, but you do the readings it's not hard to do well. One big essay split into 3 drafts. Not hard to do well in this class.

Professor Pathakis did an excellent job encouraging discussion, while in her class it never felt weird to disagree with her points, as long as you have the facts. This class was very encouraging to think outside the box. Take her if you like critical learning rather than memorization
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Pathakis is very knowledgeable and genuinely wants you to learn. She offers a comfortable classroom environment for an objectively hard topic. Lectures are discussion-based and cold calls are a part of your grade. But this shouldn't scare you away because she is very gracious and helps lead you to answers if you get stuck.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you don't take Dr. Pathakis, you are missing out. If you do the readings and show up to class, you WILL succeed. She cold calls but any answer will get you extra credit and you won't be penalized. Pop quizzes are easy if you completed readings. Dr. Pathakis cares about her students learning and wants them to get good grades. TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Pathakis' syllabus was wildly unorganized. There were updates to the syllabus weekly. She cold calls in class and looks for very specific answers so be ready. The class subject was very interesting but I don't think she did a lot to make it interesting.

I took Race and Politics with Dr. Pathakis and loved it! The material is very interesting. She cold calls, but you get extra credit for it. She gives pop quizzes so make sure you show up to class and do the readings (they're easy if you did the reading). Go to her office hours for help or to just chill and chat with her, she's really cool and nice!

Dr. Pathakis was really great and really cared about the material she was teaching! She has really interesting lectures and cares about you as a student. She is really accessible outside of class. There are pop quizzes each week over reading material and a research paper due at the end of the semester. I really suggest taking the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: shes such a good professor! she really knows what she talks about and hope i can take other classes with her in the future! she has pop quizzes (only 5 questions) sometimes before the class begins but they are quite easy if you read the required material beforehand!!
